assertions.name: dimension_claim_K_minus_3_over_2
assertions.unit: 0 iff dim = (K−3)/2 = half−1 holds for every K; 1 otherwise (currently all 4 primes match)
assertions.source: Galois-pair count (K−1)/2 minus one orbit-sum relation (modulo ζ(3)).

assertions.name: orbit_sum_relation_direct_residue
assertions.unit: max over K ∈ {5,7,11,13} of |2K²·Σ Cl_3(2πj/K) + (K²−1)·ζ(3)| (direct evaluation; independent of PSLQ)
assertions.source: Multiplication formula for Li_3 at primitive Kth roots of unity, after Re and pair-merging.  The PSLQ recovery (per-K) is recorded informationally in `per_K_results.pslq_relation` — PSLQ succeeded at K=5, 7; missed the relation at K=11, 13 despite 200-dps precision (algorithm sensitivity to the small coefficient magnitudes), which is why this assertion uses direct residue rather than PSLQ outcome.

description: I1 probe for prop:cyclotomic-depth3-dimension-synthesis.  Verifies dim_ℚ 𝒱_K = (K−3)/2 for primes K ∈ {5, 7, 11, 13} where 𝒱_K is the ℚ-span of the (K−1)/2 distinct Cl_3(2πj/K) values modulo the ζ(3)-line.  Step (1): count starting generators (K−1)/2; step (2): verify the orbit-sum relation via mpmath PSLQ at 80 dps (maxcoeff = 10^{12}); step (3): confirm PSLQ recovers exactly the expected linear combination 2K² · Σ Cl_3 + (K²−1) · ζ(3) = 0 and finds no further relation — empirical support for the (K−3)/2 dimension claim.
